bear.note: Orders stay weak, guidance missed, dividend cut. Justified multiple 11x on next-12m 3.50.

valuation.whyItFits: Wide-moat radiotherapy duopoly position (Morningstar view, analyst opinion) at EV/adjusted EBIT 12; included as the value-recovery test case.
valuation.growthDrivers: Replacement cycle of linear accelerators, Evo platform, emerging-market cancer care, cost savings.
valuation.saturation: Near multi-year lows on depressed earnings; consensus target equals the price.
valuation.principalRisk: Earnings recovery keeps slipping: Q1 below guidance, order intake volatile, reported loss after 1.1bn impairments; the 4% dividend depends on recovery.
